# Lessandra

> > Lessandra is an affordable house and lot developer in the Philippines offering residential properties across multiple communities with flexible payment options and financing solutions.

Lessandra, a Vista Land subsidiary, provides affordable housing solutions throughout the Philippines with projects in key regions including Bulacan, Cavite, and Laguna. The company specializes in accessible residential subdivisions and house models designed for Filipino families seeking quality homes at competitive prices.

## Core Properties & Projects

- [Project Listings](https://lessandra.com.ph/project-listings): Browse all Lessandra projects including Monticello, Sta. Maria, Tanza Heights, and Calamba
- [Lessandra Monticello](https://lessandra.com.ph/project/lessandra-monticello): Affordable community in San Jose Del Monte, Bulacan with modern amenities
- [Lessandra Sta. Maria](https://lessandra.com.ph/project/lessandra-sta-maria): Maaliwalas community near Marilao, Bulacan offering peaceful residential living
- [Lessandra Tanza Heights](https://lessandra.com.ph/project/lessandra-tanza-heights): Affordable homes in Tanza, Cavite with convenient Metro access
- [Lessandra Calamba](https://lessandra.com.ph/project/lessandra-calamba): Maaliwalas community in Calamba City, Laguna for comfortable family living

## House Models & Listings

- [House Listings](https://lessandra.com.ph/house-listings): Explore Lessandra house models including Step Up Series, Sienna, Starter Series, and Arielle
- [Arielle Townhouse](https://lessandra.com.ph/house/arielle): 2-storey 2-bedroom affordable townhouse model with modern design
- [Criselle House](https://lessandra.com.ph/house/criselle): 2-storey 2-bedroom affordable house model ideal for growing families
